# Code of conduct

Be respectful, patient, and specific. Critique code and decisions rather than
people, protect private data, and respect licenses, trademarks, and coordinated
security disclosure.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, spam, deliberate privacy violations, and
knowingly malicious contributions are not accepted. Maintainers may edit or
remove content and restrict participation when necessary to protect the project
and its community.

Report conduct concerns through a private maintainer channel when possible.
